## load the cNMF results into R
```{r}
usage_gep = read.csv('../data/mphDC_cnmf15_usage.csv')
usage_gep$X = NULL
topgene_gep = read.csv('../data/top100g_mphdc_cnmf15.csv')
print(c(dim(usage_gep),
dim(topgene_gep))) # make sure not missing cells
meta_gep = read.csv('../data/mphdc_cnmf_meta.csv') # 16k mph cells in total
```

```{r}
### some meta forming
fullmeta = read.csv('../data/milo_mphdc_srobj2.csv')
index_mph = read.csv('../data/milo_mphdc_ann.csv')
fullmeta$mphmilo = 'Other'
fullmeta$mphmilo[index_mph$index[index_mph$type == 'p53_h']] = 'p53_h'
fullmeta$mphmilo[index_mph$index[index_mph$type == 'p53_l']] = 'p53_l'
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)

## some clean up
fullmeta$X = NULL
meta_gep$X.1 = NULL
meta_gep$X = NULL

### quick left join
common_cols <- intersect(names(meta_gep), names(fullmeta))
common_cols = common_cols[c(1:30)]
meta_gep_left <- left_join(meta_gep, fullmeta, by = common_cols)

usage_gep_sub = subset(usage_gep, meta_gep_left$mphmilo != 'Other')
meta_gep_sub = subset(meta_gep_left, meta_gep_left$mphmilo != 'Other')
usage_gep_sub$type = meta_gep_sub$mphmilo
```


### quick check what gep usages statistics and so

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)

# Select first 15 genes/programs
genes_to_plot <- colnames(usage_gep_sub)[1:15]

# Initialize plot list
plot_list <- list()

# Loop over genes
for (gene in genes_to_plot) {
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    expression = usage_gep_sub[[gene]],
    type = usage_gep_sub$type
  )

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = type, y = expression, fill = type)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.size = 0.5) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format") +
    labs(title = gene, x = NULL, y = "Expression") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  plot_list[[gene]] <- p
}

# Combine plots
wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3)
```


### quick check what gep usages statistics - effect size

```{r}
# Get first 15 genes
genes_to_test <- colnames(usage_gep_sub)[1:15]

# Initialize list to store results
effect_size_df <- data.frame(
  gene = character(),
  median_h = numeric(),
  median_l = numeric(),
  abs_diff = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Loop to compute medians and effect size
for (gene in genes_to_test) {
  expr_h <- usage_gep_sub[[gene]][usage_gep_sub$type == "p53_h"]
  expr_l <- usage_gep_sub[[gene]][usage_gep_sub$type == "p53_l"]

  med_h <- median(expr_h, na.rm = TRUE)
  med_l <- median(expr_l, na.rm = TRUE)
  diff <- abs(med_h - med_l)

  effect_size_df <- rbind(effect_size_df, data.frame(
    gene = gene,
    median_h = med_h,
    median_l = med_l,
    abs_diff = diff
  ))
}

# Sort by absolute difference
effect_size_df <- effect_size_df[order(-effect_size_df$abs_diff), ]
```


##### lets do a quick umap on all the macrophages

```{r}
library(Seurat)
seurat_obj = readRDS("../../../fig2_related/analy/data/uter_seurat_simp_2025.rds")
## do  NSMP vs p53
seurat_obj2 = subset(seurat_obj, subset = acc != '15167') #no info
seurat_obj2@meta.data$MS2 = seurat_obj2@meta.data$MS
seurat_obj2@meta.data$MS2[seurat_obj2@meta.data$MS2!= 'p53'] = 'non_p53'
seurat_obj2@meta.data$type = 'Other'
seurat_obj2@meta.data$type[seurat_obj2@meta.data$annV7_noNum == 'Macrophage/DC'] = 'Other Mph/DC'
seurat_obj2@meta.data$type[index_mph$index[index_mph$type == 'p53_h']] = 'p53_h'
seurat_obj2@meta.data$type[index_mph$index[index_mph$type == 'p53_l']] = 'p53_l'

## macropahge subset
seurat_mph = subset(seurat_obj2, annV7_noNum == 'Macrophage/DC')
seurat_mph <- RunUMAP(
  seurat_mph, 
  reduction = "harmony", 
  dims = 1:30, 
  #umap.method = "uwot", 
  n.neighbors = 15,     # try lower or higher values
  min.dist = 0.5        # try 0.01–0.5 (lower = more "trajectory-like")
)
DimPlot(seurat_mph, reduction = "umap", group.by = "type")
```


#### try to link back the GEP values ontop of the UMAP

```{r}
meta_dfmph = seurat_mph@meta.data
#meta_gep
share_coln = intersect(colnames(meta_dfmph), colnames(meta_gep))[c(1:20)]

## match
key_dfmph <- do.call(paste, c(meta_dfmph[share_coln], sep = "_"))
key_gep   <- do.call(paste, c(meta_gep[share_coln], sep = "_"))
matching_indices <- match(key_dfmph, key_gep)

## add new assay
usage_gepm = usage_gep[matching_indices,]
```


## add new assay of gep to the object
### potentially 7, 8 , 9 is interesting

```{r}
rownames(usage_gepm) = colnames(seurat_mph)
cnmfgep <- CreateAssayObject(counts = t(usage_gepm))
seurat_mph[["cnmf"]] <- cnmfgep

FeaturePlot(seurat_mph, features = c("Usage-5", "Usage-7", "Usage-8", "Usage-9", 'Usage-1'))
```

#####  now consider making better plots

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

# Extract UMAP coordinates
umap_df <- Embeddings(seurat_mph, "umap") %>% as.data.frame()
umap_df$type <- seurat_mph$type

# Label highlight and background groups
umap_df$group <- ifelse(umap_df$type %in% c("p53_h", "p53_l"), umap_df$type, "other")

# Plot
p = ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) +
  # Background cells
  geom_point(data = subset(umap_df, group == "other"),
             color = "lightgrey", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.2, shape = 16) +
  # Highlighted h/l cells
  geom_point(data = subset(umap_df, group != "other"),
             aes(color = group), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.9, shape = 16) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("p53_l" = "#547AA5", "p53_h" = "#E64B35")) +  # or choose your own palette
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()
  )
ggsave('../plots/mphDC_umap_typeV2.png', width = 6, height = 5)

p
```



```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)

# Custom "iris-like" palette (soft blue to violet-pink)
iris_palette <- c("#D0E6F5", "#89BFE2", "#6886C5", "#8F63B2", "#DB65AD")

# Get UMAP
umap_df <- Embeddings(seurat_mph, "umap") %>% as.data.frame()

features <- c("Usage-7", "Usage-8", "Usage-9")
plot_list <- list()

for (gene in features) {
  expr_raw <- FetchData(seurat_mph, vars = gene)[[1]]
  
  # Clip expression to 5–95% quantiles
  q5 <- quantile(expr_raw, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  q95 <- quantile(expr_raw, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
  expr_clipped <- pmin(pmax(expr_raw, q5), q95)

  plot_data <- umap_df
  plot_data$expr <- expr_clipped

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) +
    geom_point(
      data = subset(plot_data, expr == 0),
      color = "lightgrey", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.2, shape = 16
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = subset(plot_data, expr > 0),
      aes(color = expr),
      size = 1.1, alpha = 0.9, shape = 16
    ) +
    scale_color_gradientn(colors = iris_palette) +
    labs(title = gene) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
    )

  plot_list[[gene]] <- p
}

# Combine and export
combined <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3)
ggsave("../plots/mphDC_feature_usage_7_8_9_iris.png", combined, width = 18, height = 5, dpi = 600)

combined

```
